referee_caveats_inferred: Paper gives two different N(H2) values (1.72e20 in Section 3.2.1, 3.48e20 in Summary), A_V 23.3 vs 23.5 mag, and mass-loss uncertainty 0.1 vs 0.2e-6; the derived mass-loss rate depends on which is right
Jet width set to PSF FWHM (0.29'') makes the mass-loss rate an upper-limit-like estimate and the quoted uncertainty omits that systematic
The Boltzmann/LTE and optically-thin assumptions are questionable for the long-wavelength lines, which the paper itself says may be optically thick
Temperature, A_V and column density come from a single 0.5'' aperture at knot B2, with no stated fit weighting or residuals
Knot offsets are comparable to PSF/beam sizes and the WCS alignment is unchecked; the shock-layer interpretation is not tested against models quantitatively
Robust +2.0 is the coarsest-resolution weighting, so ALMA beams (~0.4'') are larger than the 0.22'' expected knot displacement; no robust test is shown
